critical.title: ⚡ ANALYST SIGNAL CHANGE — Peter Brandt: 'The ATH is in'
critical.text: Brandt said late Saturday (11/14) that Bitcoin's all-time high may never be surpassed in his lifetime if a bearish weekly head-and-shoulders pattern holds; BTC was $62,830, ~50% below the October 2025 record. He gave no price target (linear-scale target is negative; log scale required). This is a conviction change that lifts the Brandt lens from stale 🟡 to fresh 🔴. A bullish counter-read from James Thorne (inverse head-and-shoulders; needs $73K reclaimed, wrong below $57K) appears in the same article.
